answer: Because the timing is entered against the copper challenge, the pulse audit can replay the lantern history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 172 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 4005 identities would post 1493 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
